description: F (seq 3) is provisional and H2, one of its two witnesses, never signs a head. The owner revokes H2 under the recovery rule (seq 4, a removal-only home revocation the predecessor admits after F); its `final` carries H1's head (seq 5), which excuses H2; F's `final` with H1's head alone (seq 6) makes F final. The succession is verified.
